title: Named-service FIRST and persistent DATA
summary: XTP FIRST selects service before admission; after KEY establishment DATA follows established context. The persistent named FIRST/DATA stream is experimental and not proof of mutual authentication or raw36/L2 field readiness.
invariants: FIRST service name is not a credential
Listener allowlists and registered service classes must be checked before CNTL acceptance
Persistent KEY is a transport context, not a peer identity proof
Independent source streams have independent XTP sequence spaces
XTP SORT, DEADLINE, RATE/BURST, ALLOC and fallback are enforced only when actual code path supplies them
procedure: Validate registered operational class at admission
Authenticate remote peer against session identity before effectful privileged requests
Verify actual live listener registration at gateway before acknowledging FIRST
Repeat DATA on a persistent context where qualified; no new FIRST for every app frame

qualification_boundaries.local: named-service local UDP execution in prior qualification only
